covered_report_window: After the Friday, October 23, 2026 U.S. market close through before the Monday, October 26, 2026 U.S. market open.
market_context_summary: Rising oil and Iran-war risk pressured most U.S. stocks, the 10-year Treasury yield remained near 5%, October consumer sentiment was only 48.0, and the October flash PMI still indicated expansion. These cross-currents favor energy cash flows but raise funding and consumer-demand risk.

screened_but_excluded.reason: Confirmed Friday after-close, but recent August 2026 IPO, limited public history and insufficient event evidence.
Biotech earnings are not the primary catalyst; no earnings-based directional edge.
Lower liquidity and weaker evidence breadth than the selected bank names.

methodology.disparity_definition: Average of (direction-score range divided by two) and reversal-risk range, producing a 0-100 disagreement scale; lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.lessons_review: No new method change. Existing timing, key-metric, premium-growth, low-bar reversal and disagreement rules were applied.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: U.S./Europe volume softness; high guide bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record Q2 EBITDA, a 16%-17% full-year EBITDA growth guide and additional cost savings favor upside if margins hold despite uneven construction volumes.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $0.24 EPS and $4.45-$4.47B revenue; EBITDA margin and confirmation of the 16%-17% growth guide matter more than EPS.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Cutting Edge savings, Mexico pricing and free-cash-flow conversion keep EBITDA growth above the raised guide.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: U.S. and European volume weakness or Mexico normalization erodes margin and exposes the raised bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust public event-implied move was available; positive analyst consensus and raised guidance create some sell-the-news risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimates cluster near $0.24 EPS and $4.45-$4.47B revenue; analyst consensus remains Moderate Buy.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Q4 service growth, FCF or promo intensity
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Subscriber momentum, accelerating mobility-and-broadband service revenue and two guidance raises favor upside, with the recent SpaceX-driven reset lowering the bar.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.27 EPS and $34.77B revenue; the decisive test is postpaid phone additions and service revenue growth near management's 3% Q3 target.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Net additions, churn and service growth validate the turnaround while free cash flow supports capital returns.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: A fine quarter can still sell off if Q4 growth, promotion economics or free cash flow soften.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options imply about 3.5%; the recent SpaceX-related selloff reduced crowding but telecom competition remains the dominant positioning risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimates center near $1.27 EPS; recent estimate signals were not conclusive.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record royalty revenue, new mineral interests and firm energy prices support upside if coal tons and per-ton costs remain controlled.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Public estimates are $0.82-$0.84 EPS and roughly $603M revenue; coal segment margin and royalty EBITDA are the key metrics.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Oil-and-gas royalty growth and contracted coal volumes protect distribution coverage and cash flow.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Lower realized coal pricing, higher costs or weak tons overwhelm the royalty contribution.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust public implied move was available; income ownership may dampen the reaction.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public EPS estimates are tightly grouped at $0.82-$0.84.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Nine consecutive quarters of margin expansion, strong credit and improving efficiency create a modest upside edge if deposits stabilize.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.51-$1.52 EPS and $202.6M revenue; NIM, deposit mix and credit quality matter most.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Asset repricing outpaces funding pressure, deposits hold and buybacks reinforce EPS.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Deposit mix shifts further toward costly balances or Hawaii credit costs rise.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust public implied move was available; sector rate moves can dominate the company print.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 EPS narrowly beat; the Q3 bar implies continued double-digit year-over-year growth.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Commercial deposit mix and expense growth
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Record earnings, 7% loan growth and clean credit support a mild upside bias, but commercial deposit contraction and cost growth cap conviction.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Consensus is about $1.09 EPS and $73.7M revenue; organic C&I loan growth and NIM stability are decisive.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: C&I utilization and core deposits improve while charge-offs remain negligible.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Funding mix worsens, expenses outrun revenue or credit normalizes.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable public implied move was available; lighter liquidity can amplify a miss.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public revision breadth is sparse; primary operating trends remain constructive.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Balance-sheet restructuring and a 14bp sequential NIM gain support a mild upside call, tempered by loan contraction and concentrated deposit movements.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market is focused on whether Q2's 3.38% tax-equivalent NIM keeps expanding without renewed criticized-loan pressure.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Deposit repricing and higher loan yields extend the margin recovery while asset quality improves.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Loan runoff, CRE/wine exposure or concentrated outflows interrupt the turnaround.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable public implied move was available; thin liquidity raises gap risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Public estimate breadth is limited; the call relies mainly on primary balance-sheet data.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Strong NIM and earnings momentum are offset by a stock near its highs and acquisition execution risk.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The key question is whether the 4.32% Q2 NIM and acquired balance-sheet growth remain durable.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Margin holds, credit stays clean and Tri-County deal commentary reduces uncertainty.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Merger costs, funding pressure or credit normalization expose the elevated bar.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable public implied move was available; limited liquidity heightens reversal risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 EPS beat modestly; public Q3 revision data are thin.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: High occupancy and a raised FFO guide are constructive, but leverage and near-5% Treasury yields leave little clean event edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The decisive metric is full-year core FFO guidance of $3.07-$3.13, with occupancy and leverage as quality checks.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Guidance rises again, development leasing holds and refinancing risk eases.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Higher funding costs or leverage outweigh stable government tenancy.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust public implied move was available; REIT factor moves may dominate.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q2 guidance was raised only slightly; the market likely needs another clean raise for upside.

ranked_companies.key_risk_to_call: Growth deceleration, regulatory claims, high bar
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Nearly 20% constant-currency booking growth is attractive, but the collapse from August levels, regulatory overhang and uncertain margin bar produced no consensus edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: The market expects continued double-digit bookings and revenue growth; adjusted EBIT conversion matters more than headline bookings.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Hotel and air bookings stay strong, take rates hold and margin expands.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Growth normalizes, marketing intensity rises or regulatory commentary dominates a decent print.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No robust public implied move was available; the stock is down sharply from August levels, creating both de-risking and broken-momentum risk.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: Q1 gross bookings grew 19.9% in constant currency and IFRS revenue 16.1%; current consensus feeds are inconsistent.

ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: A 49% active-coach decline and 28% revenue contraction keep the base case bearish, but any credible stabilization could trigger a sharp relief rally.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: Management guided Q3 revenue to $60-$80M and loss per share to $0.15-$0.65; active-coach attrition and the Q4 profitability target are decisive.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Trilivy lifts coach productivity, revenue stabilizes and the Q4 profitability target holds.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Coach attrition persists, gross margin weakens and the profitability target slips.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: No reliable public implied move was available; compressed expectations make squeeze risk high.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: The public bar is low, but evidence of a durable demand turn remains limited.
